# FocusFlow

## Idea

A guided workspace that helps solo founders turn scattered product thoughts into one governed next step.

## Target User

Solo founders maintaining an early-stage software product.

## Problem

Product context and delivery decisions are scattered across conversations, repositories, and task trackers.

## Promise

Produce one traceable next product-delivery action without requiring the founder to manage internal agent mechanics.

## Mechanism

Normalize one approved brainstorm into a governed product baseline and route it to founder focus.

## Channel

Founder-operated product repositories.

## Solution Path

Own-pain solution.

## Assumptions

- Founders will prefer a guided workflow over manually maintaining governance documents.
- One baseline can reduce repeated context reconstruction.

## Unknowns

- Which minimum fields make the first guided session useful?

## Evidence

- The founder believes scattered context is slowing delivery.
